Leaving those words behind, she walked away.

My gratitude to you.
My Virgil—or perhaps, my Beatrice.

You have bestowed upon me a brand new perspective!
Just like "Sunrise," vibrant, impressionistic, and unforgettable!

Then I shall serve you. As you well know,
you owe me a duty of intoxication. Now then, what is your desire?
...My cup runneth over.

I intoxicate you—yet that is not the end of it!
You too intoxicate me in return!

What she pursues is—the "fleeting moment."
That doesn't seem to change even during summer training camp.

A hill overlooking the sea. The lush greenery standing against the view
made the scenery far more vibrant than the beach below.

Ha ha ha! Ah ha ha!
AHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!!!!!!

Negative, though I shall find one soon enough.
In this realm beyond the everyday, countless encounters, partings, and fleeting moments await.
...Hm? Is that—

I go to seek them out. To chase the light that vanishes in the blink of an eye
is the true calling of I, Gimlet. —Pardon me.

What magnificent fortune! When you gaze into the abyss,
the abyss gazes right back into you!
Whoa, that sounds awesome...! If I can wake up early, I'd love to check it out!
......Heh, ha ha—

—That is precisely what I desire.
I act to attain that pinnacle. Therefore, I run.

A magnificent response. If so, I shall always be
prepared to pour you the finest vintage.
...Daybreak—

An occurrence spanning a mere fleeting second, an instantaneous phenomenon!!!!
A spectacle intensely seared into memory, never to be forgotten—!!!!

AHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!!!!!!
You amazed me, Trainer, truly amazed me!!!!!!
...Oho.

As summer training camp reached its final stage,
Tanino Gimlet completed her routine smoothly as always.

Even now, some time later,
Tanino Gimlet continues to gaze contentedly at the horizon.
What a magnificent—daybreak!!!!!!!

You know this well. The path I tread is not the royal road.
It is a road so treacherous, even the morning star is pierced through.
...Or so I thought, until that very moment.

There's a path leading down nearby. Just as those Umamusume
were saying, you can surely get a clear view of the sunrise from the horizon—
...It is only natural to rejoice.

I take it you shall naturally continue
to illuminate my path ahead... yes?

I've never had any reason to go there, so I've never visited.
Since I have some free time, this feels like the perfect chance.

Yet... you offered yourself as my guide.
That resolve is the very light that illuminates purgatory itself.

Once more—starting with a single drop of lime.
I shall serve it, for you, and for my destiny.

Tanino Gimlet seems poised to serve me a drink,
but that's not why I called her out here.

Tanino Gimlet looks out toward the ocean.
At that moment—a brilliant crimson sunrise emerges over the horizon.
Ah!! Indeed!! Indeed!! Truly, indeed, it is!!!!

A place where hues intersect as in a painting...
Did you find yourself yearning to savor fine wine amidst this contrast?

I don't think I did anything so grandiose,
but if she's happy, nothing could be better.

A fragment of the missing page has fallen perfectly into place.
Let us take our leave for today.
Very well. If that is all you desire.
...How unusual. For you to summon me.
After walking for a few minutes, the place I arrived at was—

—Right! The hidden beach around the back is a total secret spot!
The view is gorgeous, especially during sunrise!

That's it...! From here, she should definitely be able to see it.
The fleeting moment the sun rises above the horizon—!

With that, I immediately sent a message to Tanino Gimlet,
attaching the location of this spot.

I don't have any specific plans right now either.
Taking a break, I decided to explore the surrounding area.

That which scatters in an instant, shines, and is born anew.
That which burns deeply into the mind, evoking profound reflection.
—And then, the following morning.
Heh... Heh-heh, an exquisite feeling.
Before long, dusk fell, and night deepened—
